mutations.name: close-pr closes without comparing GitHub's head to the confirmed head
mutations.find: if (pull.headSha !== op.headSha) return { outcome: "moved", currentHead: pull.headSha };
kills: close-pr answers moved and closes nothing when the PR is open at another head

mutations.name: close-pr ignores its own done row on a replay
kills: close-pr answers already on a replay after done, and closes only once

mutations.name: close-pr reads an interrupted earlier call as closed elsewhere
mutations.find: return interrupted(history) && !pull.merged ? finishInterrupted(op, deps) : gone(op, pull);
kills: close-pr finishes a started row with no done whose close landed: already, and the Shepherd run it skipped ends

mutations.name: close-pr leaves the PR's Shepherd run live after the close
mutations.find:
await deps.port.closePr(op.repo, op.pr);
  await endShepherdRun(deps, op);
kills: close-pr ends the PR's live Shepherd run after the close

mutations.name: close-pr counts this call's own started row as an interrupted earlier call
kills: close-pr answers gone for a PR closed elsewhere with no ledger row for this record
